verdict: No significant, material deterioration versus the baseline. The location and cause sections describe the background pattern of the (few) problem arrivals, not a new issue.

evidence: 100% of late trains were already late at 6 Av (inherited delay). Origins: at or before Lorimer St: 133, at Bedford Av: 20, at 1 Av: 16, at 6 Av: 12. Largest time loss on segment 6 Av -> target (median +90s vs schedule).
96% of headway gaps at the target already existed at 6 Av.
7% of problem arrivals occurred during planned service changes (lift 2.5x).
MTA reports 'Planned ROW Work' as 27% of delays on line(s) L (1.2x the system share) in the analysed months.
ETAs for problem arrivals drifted 118s on average vs 51s otherwise (2.3x): trains are being held or re-dispatched upstream.
MTA reports 'Infrastructure & Equipment' as 40% of delays on line(s) L (1.1x the system share) in the analysed months.
MTA reports 'Police & Medical' as 19% of delays on line(s) L (0.9x the system share) in the analysed months.
5% of problem arrivals happened while an MTA 'track' alert was active for the line (problem rate 36% with an alert vs 28% without, lift 1.3x).
